title: Mendral’s team joins Anthropic as its hosted developer product closes
friendlyTitle: Mendral’s developer-tools team is moving to Anthropic
summary: The Mendral team is joining Anthropic to work on Claude Platform after building tools for CI diagnosis, flaky-test repair and dependency review. Mendral says it is winding down its hosted product and contacting current customers about the transition.
friendlySummary: The team behind Mendral will work on Anthropic’s Claude Platform. Mendral’s online service is closing and customers are being moved off it.
whyItMatters: Anthropic is adding developer-tool expertise while a smaller standalone service disappears. Existing Mendral users need a migration plan, and the move signals that CI and maintenance automation remain a strategic part of coding-agent platforms.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Mendral customers should plan their replacement workflow. The move also shows that AI companies want tools that fix routine software maintenance work.
